screenshots.caption: Choose Check now beside Answer service. This example shows an unavailable service; it is not a live status report.
Your answer appears below the question box. Sources and details, Act on this and Save stay with it.
Include in every agent run pins the note. If saving fails, your words stay in place beside Retry save.
Read the attached answer, edit your follow-up, then click Act. Clear answer context removes the attachment.
The question and its context stay above your answer. Submit answer sends your response back to the agent.
Now, History and Risk change the view. Owners review what is included and excluded before downloading an export.
Include earlier versions shows the earlier entry alongside its replacement. Certainty remains visible on both.
Check sources, permissions, timing, cost limits and expiry. Only the owner can activate the reviewed schedule.
The new agent is already on the team. Full change details keeps its complete settings available to the owner.

scope: Screenshots are isolated local UI test examples; HubSpot note reflects the separate live read-only verification on 2026-09-14.
